ticker.name: KUSURI NO AOKI HOLDINGS CO LTD

business_summary: Kusuri No Aoki Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the retail of pharmaceutical, cosmetic, and daily good products in Japan. The company offers vitamin and diet supplements; and first aid and health care supplies. It also offers facial cleanser, body soap, shampoo, and toothpaste, etc. In addition, the company provides baby products, such as diapers, nursing care, sanitary products, detergent, and household products, as well as clothing products, such as socks, underwear, and home appliances. Further, it offers processed food, daily food, fresh food, seasoning, sweets, drinks, and alcohol, as well as provides pet foods. Kusuri No Aoki Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Hakusan, Japan.
business_summary_ko: 구스리노아오키홀딩스(Kusuri No Aoki Holdings Co., Ltd.)는 일본에서 의약품, 화장품, 생활용품 소매업을 영위하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 비타민과 다이어트 보조제를 제공합니다. 응급 처치 및 의료 용품. 그 밖에도 기저귀, 간호용품, 위생용품, 세제, 생활용품 등 유아용품과 양말, 속옷, 가전제품 등 의류제품도 판매하고 있다. 또한, 가공식품, 일용식품, 신선식품, 조미료, 과자, 음료, 주류 등을 판매하고 있으며, 반려동물 사료도 제공하고 있습니다. Kusuri No Aoki Holdings Co., Ltd.는 1999년에 설립되었으며 일본 하쿠산에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
